info.name: Kombo REST API
info.description: Example requests for every operation of the Kombo REST API. Set the baseUrl variable to the address of the backend (https://localhost by default). The backend uses a self-signed certificate: disable "SSL certificate verification" in the Postman settings. Log in first with "Auth > Log in": Postman keeps the httpOnly session cookie and sends it in the next requests. The sample users are customer@kombo.com / customer and employee@kombo.com / employee; the administrator is admin@kombo.com with the password configured in KOMBO_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login flow: log in, check the logged in user and log out. The JWT travels in the httpOnly cookie kombo_token.

request.description: Checks the email and password. Answers 200 with the user and the Set-Cookie header with the session JWT (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict), or 401 with wrong credentials. Change the email and password variables to log in with another user.
Returns the logged in user (200), or 401 without a valid session cookie.
Deletes the session cookie (204).
Returns the first page of active products of the menu (10 per page by default). The response has the products in `content` and the page information in `page`.

item.name: Get products by page and size

request.description: Returns a page of active products. `page` starts at 0, `size` is the number of products per page and `sort` is the property used to sort them.
Returns the active products of a category (case insensitive), paginated.
Returns the detail of a product or combo: its ingredients with the quantity used and, for a combo, its products.
Returns the picture of the product as binary content, with its type (for example image/jpeg) in the Content-Type header. Returns 404 if the product does not exist or has no picture.

item.name: Get product that does not exist (404)

request.description: Example of error: returns 404 Not Found in ProblemDetail format.
Example of error: returns 400 Bad Request in ProblemDetail format.
Every product and kombo, also the deactivated ones. Optional filters active (true or false) and combo (true: only kombos; false: only products). Log in as the administrator first.
A product or kombo, also when it is deactivated, with active and imageId.
201 with the new product and the Location header. The category is Burgers, Sides, Drinks or Desserts (Combos is only for kombos); the ingredients are existing ones (400 otherwise).
Replaces the data and the ingredients of a product. 400 for a kombo (use Change a kombo).

A deactivated product leaves the menu. 409 if an active kombo includes it, with the ids and names of the kombos in the "products" property. Send true to activate it again (409 for a kombo with a deactivated product).

item.name: Upload the picture of a product (administrator)

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP picture of 1 MB at most

request.description: Picture of a product or kombo as multipart/form-data in the field "image": JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP of 10 MB at most (400 if it is not a picture, 413 if it is bigger). Choose the file in the body.

item.name: Get the picture of a product (administrator)

request.description: The picture also of a deactivated product (no-cache).
201 with the new kombo (category Combos) and the Location header. Only active products that are not kombos, each once, with at least 2 units in total (400 otherwise).
Replaces the data and the products of a kombo.
Every ingredient sorted by name, to choose the ingredients of a product.

item.name: Users
item.description: Each user can only read their own data; the administrator can read any user.

request.description: Creates a customer (public). 201 with the new user and the Location header; it does not log in. Change the email to repeat it.

item.name: Sign up with an email already registered (409)

request.description: 409 Conflict: the email belongs to the sample customer.
400 Bad Request: the detail lists each invalid field.
Paginated list of users. Only the administrator: 401 without login and 403 with another role.

The administrator creates a customer or an employee (role CUSTOMER or EMPLOYEE) with their first password. 201 with the new user and the Location header (/api/v1/users/{id}); 409 if the email is already registered, 401 without session and 403 for other roles. Log in as the administrator first.
There is only one administrator: the role ADMIN is rejected with 400 ("role: must be CUSTOMER or EMPLOYEE").
Account of any user. Only the administrator: 403 for other roles (also with their own id; they use /auth/me), 401 without login.
Order history of the logged in user, the most recent first, paginated. 401 without session.

item.name: Get the orders of a user

request.description: Order history of any user, the most recent first (paginated). Only the administrator: 403 for other roles (they use /users/me/orders).
Name, surname and phone of the logged in user (the email cannot be changed and is ignored if sent). 200 with the user, 400 with the invalid fields, 401 without session.
The current password and the new one (8 to 72 characters). 204, or 400 if the current password is wrong or the new one is not valid. With the sample customer, change it back afterwards.
The whole list of saved addresses: sending the list with or without an address adds or deletes it. 200 with the user, 400 for a blank address.

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP picture of 1 MB at most

request.description: Multipart form with the field "image" (choose a file in the Body tab). 200 with the user and the imageId of the picture, 400 if the file is not a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP picture, 413 if it is bigger than 1 MB.
The profile picture as binary content with its type in Content-Type (Cache-Control: no-cache). 404 without picture.
204. The initial of the name is shown again.

Deletes the account of the logged in user with their addresses and picture and deletes the session cookie (204). The orders are kept without the customer data. 403 for the administrator. Do not use it with the sample users.

Only the administrator: deletes any account (204) except the one of the administrator (403). The orders are kept without the customer data.

Checkout (anonymous, customer or employee; 403 for the administrator). The server takes the prices from the database and adds the delivery cost. 201 with the order, its number (1000 + id) and the Location header.

item.name: Place a home delivery without address (400)

request.description: A home delivery needs a delivery address: 400 in ProblemDetail format.
Detail of an order. Employees and the administrator can read any order; a customer only their own (403 otherwise). 404 if it does not exist.
Log in as employee@kombo.com first. Counter order: only the name of the customer is required (email and phone can be empty). Not paid until it is marked as paid if it is paid in cash.
Order dashboard (employees and administrator; 403 for customers): orders in preparation and ready, oldest first.

item.name: Get the finished orders of a day (employee)

request.description: Orders delivered and cancelled placed from a local date and time (since), the most recent first. 400 for a date that is not valid.

item.name: Mark a cash order as paid (employee)

request.description: Employees and administrator. Only for cash orders that are not cancelled; marking it again changes nothing.

item.name: Change the status of an order (employee)

request.description: Employees and administrator. IN_PREPARATION → READY → DELIVERED, or CANCELLED before it is delivered. 409 for a change that is not possible (for example, delivering an order that is not paid), 400 without status or paid.
Public. Delivery cost of home deliveries and the subtotal from which delivery is free.
Only the administrator (log in with the administrator first). 400 if the cost is negative or above 99.99.
